items.title: Weekend frozen-carry persists into a fresher after-hours snapshot while the lone crypto mover RE-DATES and ticks up: the BTC-USD real-asset leg re-stamps from 08-01 to 08-02 and rises 29.3 -> 31.4, yet the completed daily bar never advances (287 bars, still 07-30) and every deterministic regime / bench / other Tier-A read stays byte-for-byte identical
items.note: This after-hours coverage run consumes a NEWER snapshot (asOf 2026-08-02T03:07:05.490Z) than the earlier same-day windows, and the pattern is a continued weekend frozen carry with a single re-dated mover. (1) The deterministic regime and bench remain IDENTICAL to Friday's 07-31 close AND to the earlier 08-01 pre-market / morning / pre-close windows: VIX 15.99, band 'VIX 16.0', score 0 (calm / positive-gamma, Fear-Greed unavailable); SPY 747.03, ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05% - no delta. (2) The Tier-A sector read is frozen: XLY still the low-conviction rotate-into (Improving quad I, accel +0.9, rsMom 100.74) but structurally weak and UNCHANGED - bear-stack, ma200Dist -0.52, negative on all RS-momentum horizons (rsMom1m -1.86, rsMom3m -5.93, rsMom6m -12.03); XLE the rotate-out, XLV the fading level-leader; 11 scored. (3) The SINGLE moving datum is again the crypto daily-dated leg, and it now RE-DATES: BTC-USD advances its stamp from asOf 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z to 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z and its score rises from the earlier after-hours 29.3 to 31.4, still Downtrend (mom21 -0.69, mom63 -14.09, mom126 -4.46). IBIT 26.3, CPER 54.4, GLD 16.6, SLV 0, DBC 50.5, USO 43.4 are all frozen; ETF momentum (JMOM 14.45%) repeats and global rotation eases only fractionally (EWS 83.2 -> 82.6). (4) The completed daily bar has NOT advanced: 287 bars (updated 2026-08-02T03:07:00.580Z), the SAME count carried through every Friday window and the earlier 08-01 windows, so the 07-31 bar was never appended - the distinct completed bar date is still 07-30. Even with a newer snapshot timestamp and a re-dated, higher crypto quote, persistence still cannot advance (still 1 distinct completed bar), the rotate-into stays labelled low-conviction / improving-not-leading, and the lone weekend-priced crypto leg reads as noise on an unadvanced bar, not confirmation.
items.method: Extend the 'weekend frozen-carry lone-mover' detector to handle a NEWER same-day snapshot in which the lone mover's asOf DATE itself advances but no completed market bar posts. Fire when FOUR tests hold: (1) REGIME + BENCH ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL to the prior same-day / last-close windows = VIX, band, score, SPY px, ma50Dist, ma200Dist, mom126 and mom252 all equal the prior values (here VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0 and SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05% match Friday close and the earlier 08-01 windows) - a pure carry; (2) THE SAME SINGLE owning-tool metric is the only material mover (here BTC-USD; every other Tier-A read repeats, global rotation moving only a fractional 83.2 -> 82.6 with unchanged leadership order); (3) THAT METRIC'S asOf DATE advances (here 08-01 -> 08-02) and/or its score moves (29.3 -> 31.4) - record the re-date and the delta but DO NOT treat a re-dated off-hours crypto quote as a market-bar advance; (4) NO COMPLETED-BAR ADVANCE = equity bar count unchanged (287) so the just-closed 07-31 session's daily bar was never appended, keeping the distinct completed-bar date at 07-30. HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only; a re-dated, higher off-hours crypto quote on the same unadvanced 07-30 daily bar never increments the persistence counter (still 1) and cannot be graded persistent until the 07-31 bar is appended.

bars.note: Same 287-bar count as every Friday (07-31) window and the earlier 08-01 windows; even a full weekend after the 07-31 session closed the completed 07-31 daily bar has NOT been appended, so the after-hours sector read still layers 07-31 prices on the completed 07-30 daily bar.

loneMover.note: Only owning-tool metric to move materially this window; the crypto daily-dated leg RE-STAMPS from 08-01 to 08-02 and its score rises 29.3 -> 31.4 while still Downtrend. A re-dated off-hours quote on an unadvanced 07-30 equity bar: noise, not a market-bar advance and not confirmation.

frozenLegs.note: Sector RRG, ETF momentum (JMOM 14.45%) and all non-crypto real-asset legs repeat the prior windows' values; global rotation eased only fractionally (EWS 83.2 -> 82.6) with unchanged leadership order - a static board around the single re-dated BTC-USD leg that rose to 31.4.
